messages:
anna-support: FYI customer (AcmeApps) opened a billing escalation — dashboard shows ~1.2M tokens for 02:00-02:40 UTC but invoice shows ~0.7M. They say usage suddenly drops mid-window. Can infra take a look?

sam-sre: on it. any obvious errors in the metering pipeline?

maria-billing: reproduced with their customer id. Dashboard event counts line up with ingestion until ~02:12 UTC then a hard gap until ~02:38. Invoice derivation pipeline shows no events in that gap.

kevin-ops: checking eventstore offsets now. looks like partition-7 had a short leader election around 02:10. logs show many client retries then timeouts. could be messages not durably committed to the main ingestion topic.

zoe-eng: if commits dropped we might have an eventual catch-up if producers replay, but billing uses the aggregator stream which depends on committed offsets. need to know if events were lost or just delayed.

replay-bot: Triggered ingest-catchup job id=catchup-2026-11-23-02-40 by @sam-sre. Estimated work: 420k events across partitions 5-9.

sam-sre: started tailing the catchup job. logs: ```INFO starting catchup job catchup-2026-11-23-02-40
INFO scan eventstore partitions [5..9] from offset 1123456 to 1137890
WARN found 0x23 duplicate-event-id in batch, applying dedupe
ERROR write to aggregator failed: 409 conflict: checksum-mismatch on key usage-agg-20261123-02```

maria-billing: checksum-mismatch is suspicious — our billing aggregator writes per-tenant daily shards with an md5 checksum to ensure idempotence. If the shard was compacted or TTLed prematurely, a re-ingest can hit a different state and get rejected.

kevin-ops: I see a compaction job that ran at 02:15 to prune ephemeral shards older than 24h; config drift meant some daily-agg shards were included. That lines up with the leader election time. That would make replays conflict with the aggregator's expected baseline.

zoe-eng: mitigation: (1) pause compaction for affected tenant shards, (2) run catchup in idempotent mode that computes diffs before applying, (3) regenerate invoice deltas for the window. I'll open a patch to the catchup tool to fallback to override-apply when checksum mismatch + verification flag is set.

anna-support: Customer is asking for timeline and credits. We should prepare an initial SHPR and offer pro-rated credits until reconciliation completes. Maria, can you estimate credit amount if we restore the missing ~500k tokens?

maria-billing: ballpark: 500k tokens ~ $12.50 at current rates. I'll hold off on issuing until we confirm final reconciled tokens. will draft a credit hold notice.

sam-sre: catchup job currently paused due to checksum error. moving to manual apply window. Running manual diff tool now: ```python
# diff pseudocode
remote = read_aggregator_shard(shard_key)
replay = aggregate(events_range)
diff = replay - remote
if abs(diff) > threshold: write_patch(diff)
```

kevin-ops: note: while we do manual patches, telemetry for the billing pipelines will show spikes. advise support+sales to avoid automated notifications.

replay-bot: catchup-2026-11-23-02-40 status: paused -> manual_review_required (owner: zoe-eng). logs stored at s3://redwood-ops/catchups/catchup-2026-11-23-02-40/logs.tar.gz

zoe-eng: manual patch applied for tenant AcmeApps. Reconciled +498,342 tokens for 02:00-02:40 window. Ran checksum verification after write.

maria-billing: ledger-bot, please re-run invoice delta job for invoice period 2026-11-23 with override flag set to include manual patches.

ledger-bot: Invoice delta re-run queued (job id: invoice-delta-20261123-override). Estimated completion 30m.

anna-support: thanks all. I'll update the customer: we found a compaction config drift + partition leader election that caused committed offset gaps; we performed a manual catchup and patched the aggregator. Holding credit until invoice delta job completes.

sam-sre: action items: 1) kevin: revert compaction drift + add validation (ETA 1h). 2) zoe: extend catchup tool to fallback override mode and add pre-check (ETA EOD). 3) maria: prepare credit hold notice template and final numbers (ETA after ledger job). 4) ops: add postmortem blameless draft (ETA tomorrow).

kevin-ops: ack, I'll also add an alert for partition leader flaps that cross 30s within a window.

maria-billing: ledger-bot update: invoice-delta-20261123-override completed. Final reconciled delta: +498,342 tokens applied. Sending adjusted invoice to AcmeApps.

anna-support: customer notified, accepts credit hold and wants postmortem. closing thread after postmortem draft posted. :white_check_mark:
